meta.title: Franklin
meta.subtitle: Hood hurls the Army of Tennessee across two miles of open ground at Schofield's entrenched arc south of the Harpeth.

belligerents.name: Army of the Ohio, with the IV Corps and Wilson's cavalry

sun.note: Professor J. G. Porter computed sunset at Franklin that day as 4:59 p.m. local time; the low western hills made it look earlier [cox].

meta.strengthNote: Union: 29,234 of all arms, including about 5,500 cavalry [cox]. Confederate: 27,000-31,000 in the army [wp], about 20,000-24,000 in the assault [abt] [cox] [tnenc]. Union losses 2,326 [cox] [or]. Confederate losses 6,252 as counted when Franklin was reoccupied [cox] [or]; Hood reported 4,500 [hood]. Brigade strengths are estimates (only Cockrell's 696 is sourced [cox]), and losses per moment are an allocation of the sourced totals following the narrative.
meta.method: Brigade positions are read off two modern maps based on Jacobson's study and georeferenced against the Carter House, Lotz House, Carnton, Fort Granger and the town square (16 m error) [jesp]. The Union works are checked against the 1864 field-works survey [fw] and Cox's description [cox]. Positions after dark, and the exact frontages of the compressed Confederate brigades at the works, are approximate.
meta.notes: The Union earthworks themselves are not drawn: the units in the works mark the line. The terrain is modern; quarry and pond changes away from the field were masked or left as noted in terrain_config.json. No historical-map overlay is offered. Brigade strengths and losses per moment are estimates; see brief.md.

phases.label: Hood deploys
phases.title: Two armies face each other across two miles
phases.text: Schofield's infantry holds an arc of earthworks south of Franklin, both flanks on the Harpeth, while the trains cross north towards Nashville [cox] [jesp]. Wagner has left two brigades half a mile out on a rise across the Columbia Pike [wp] [cox]. Below Winstead Hill, Stewart's corps forms east of the pike and Cheatham's west of it; Lee's corps is still on the road [hood] [jesp] [fw].
tactic: An entrenched line with clear fields of fire and both flanks on obstacles forces an attacker to come straight at it.
events: Wagner's two brigades stand exposed in front of the main line [cox]

phases.label: The advance
phases.title: A two-mile line steps off
phases.text: About 20,000 Confederates advance in parade order across open ground, with almost no artillery support [abt] [hood] [cox]. East of the river Forrest's Buford and Jackson push across Hughes's Ford to turn the Union left [wp].
tactic: Attacking an entrenched enemy head-on over open ground trades the attacker's numbers for the defender's fire.
events: Forrest's cavalry crosses at Hughes's Ford [wp]
phases.debate: Hood, the American Battlefield Trust and Jespersen give about 4 p.m.; the Tennessee Encyclopedia gives 4:30. This map follows 4 p.m. [hood] [abt] [tnenc].

phases.label: Wagner overrun
phases.title: "Go into the works with them"
phases.text: The Confederate line overlaps Lane and Conrad, who fire one volley and break. Nearly 700 are captured; the rest run up the pike with Cleburne's and Brown's men at their heels, and the defenders in the works cannot fire without hitting them [wp] [abt] [cox].
tactic: An advanced force caught in front of the main line masks that line's fire as it falls back.
events: Wagner's men flee towards the works; about 700 are taken [wp]

phases.label: Breakthrough at the Carter House
phases.title: The line breaks at the pike
phases.text: Cleburne, Brown and French converge on the gap at the pike. The 100th Ohio and Strickland's front regiments are driven back and Confederates penetrate about 50 yards into the line, turning captured guns [wp] [hood]. East of the railroad Stewart's corps, squeezed against the river, stalls in the osage-orange abatis under fire from Fort Granger; Adams dies on the parapet [wp]. Wilson's cavalry drives Forrest back across the Harpeth [wp] [abt].
tactic: A break-in at a single point is only decisive if reserves can widen it before the defender's reserves seal it.
events: Confederates break 50 yards into the line at the Carter House [wp]
Cleburne killed near the cotton gin [wp] [hood]

phases.label: Opdycke's counterattack
phases.title: The breach is sealed
phases.text: Opdycke deploys his veterans astride the pike and charges into the breach on his own initiative; Stanley, arriving, gives no orders and is wounded. Reilly's reserve regiments east of the pike rally the fugitives. Hand-to-hand fighting in the Carter garden restores the line, and the Confederates are pinned in the outer ditch [wp] [abt] [hood].
tactic: A reserve held close behind the threatened point can counterattack before a break-in becomes a breakthrough.
events: Opdycke's brigade retakes the works at the pike [wp]
Close combat in the Carter house garden [wp] [hood]
phases.debate: Cox credits Opdycke's initiative and Reilly's reserves; Stanley's supporters later credited Stanley. Stanley himself wrote that he gave Opdycke no orders [wp] [cox].

phases.label: Sunset
phases.title: The flanks fail as the light goes
phases.text: The sun sets at about five [cox]. On the Union right Bate's division finally reaches the works past Everbright, without the support it expected from Chalmers, whose dismounted troopers are fighting Kimball out of Bate's sight; both are repulsed [wp]. At the centre the Confederates renew their assaults again and again from the ditch [cox] [tnenc].
tactic: A flank attack needs time and coordination; started late and unsupported, it becomes just another frontal assault.
events: Bate's single line is stopped at the works [wp]

phases.label: Johnson's attack
phases.title: Lee's one division goes in after dark
phases.text: Hood commits Edward Johnson's division, the only one of Lee's corps to have arrived. Guideless in the dark, it loses its alignment around Privet Knob and attacks the works west of the Carter House in a single assault, which is repulsed with heavy loss [wp] [hood].
tactic: Committing a reserve piecemeal and in darkness against an intact line adds losses without changing the result.
events: Johnson's division repulsed in one assault [wp]

phases.label: Stalemate at the works
phases.title: Firing dies down
phases.text: Effective fire ends about nine o'clock, though the Tennessee Encyclopedia has fighting until ten [cox] [hood] [tnenc]. Union troops hold the inside of the works and Confederates the outer ditch, a few feet apart [tnenc].
tactic: Once the attacker's momentum is spent at the parapet, the defender's line wins by simply holding.
events: The dead lie five or six deep in the ditch [tnenc]

phases.label: Withdrawal
phases.title: Schofield crosses the Harpeth
phases.text: Schofield's withdrawal order was issued at 7:15 p.m.; near midnight the infantry leaves the works and crosses the river towards Nashville, leaving dead and wounded on the field [cox] [hood]. Hood, claiming the field, has lost 6,252 men by Schofield's count, including six generals killed or mortally wounded [cox] [or].
tactic: A defender who has won the fight can still decline the next one, slipping away under cover of darkness.
events: Union infantry crosses the Harpeth bridges [cox]
Carnton becomes a Confederate field hospital [tnenc]
phases.debate: Schofield's count of 6,252 Confederate losses was made after Franklin was reoccupied in December; Hood reported 4,500, and Cox estimated about 8,000 including the lightly wounded. The chart follows 6,252 [cox] [hood] [or].

units.name: Lane's brigade (Wagner)
units.note: Left forward on the rise half a mile south of the works; collapsed when the Confederate line overlapped it [wp] [cox].

units.name: Conrad's brigade (Wagner)
units.note: East of the pike in the advanced position; most of Wagner's 670 missing came from Lane and Conrad [cox].

units.name: Opdycke's brigade (Wagner)
units.note: Refused to stop in the advanced position and halted about 200 yards north of the Carter House; its charge sealed the breach [wp] [abt].

units.name: Strickland's brigade (Ruger)
units.note: From the pike to Locust Grove; its front regiments were driven back to the retrenchment at the Carter House and recovered with Opdycke [wp] [cox].

units.name: Moore's brigade (Ruger)
units.note: Held the works from Locust Grove to the Carter's Creek Pike; Cox calls its missing trifling [cox] [jesp].

units.name: Reilly's brigade, front line
units.note: Held the pike to the cotton gin; the 100th Ohio was driven back in the breakthrough [wp] [jesp].

units.name: Reilly's reserve: 12th and 16th Kentucky, 175th Ohio
units.note: Stood in the second line and became the rally point that sealed the breach east of the pike; the 12th Kentucky carried Henry repeaters [wp].

units.name: Casement's brigade (Reilly)
units.note: East of the cotton gin; its cross fire shattered Cleburne's and French's assaults [wp] [jesp].

units.name: Stiles's brigade (Reilly)
units.note: Anchored the left on the railroad cut and the river behind an osage-orange abatis; repulsed Loring twice [wp] [jesp].

units.name: Grose's brigade (Kimball)
units.note: Left brigade of Kimball's division, joining Ruger near the Carter's Creek Pike [jesp] [cox].

units.name: Kirby's brigade (Kimball)
units.note: Lightly engaged with Chalmers's dismounted cavalry [wp] [cox].

units.name: Whitaker's brigade (Kimball)
units.note: Covered the right back to the Harpeth below the town [jesp] [cox].

units.name: Wood's division (IV Corps)
units.note: Held north of the river to cover the crossings and Fort Granger [jesp] [fw].

units.name: Fort Granger batteries
units.note: Enfiladed Stewart's corps from across the river [wp] [jesp].

units.name: Batteries at the Carter House
units.note: Guns at the pike were briefly overrun and turned in the breakthrough [jesp] [hood].

units.name: 6th Ohio Battery at the cotton gin
units.note: Fired from the salient that Reilly chose as his headquarters [cox] [jesp].

units.name: Battery G 1st Ohio and Battery M 4th U.S.
units.note: Fired canister down the railroad cut on the far left [wp] [jesp].

units.name: Hatch's cavalry division (Wilson)
units.note: Came south from the Brentwood road and charged Forrest's dismounted troopers near Hughes's Ford [wp] [abt].

units.name: Croxton's brigade (Wilson)
units.note: Struck Forrest's flank with Spencer carbines [wp].

units.name: Scott's brigade (Loring)
units.note: Loring's division twice assaulted Stiles near the railroad and river [wp].

units.name: Featherston's brigade (Loring)
units.note: Fell back under fire when Loring rode out in front of it [wp].

units.name: Adams's brigade (Loring)
units.note: Adams was killed on the parapet trying to seize the 65th Illinois's colours [wp].

units.name: Quarles's brigade (Walthall)
units.note: Reached the works through the abatis and was pinned there; by the end a captain commanded it [wp].

units.name: Reynolds's brigade (Walthall)
units.note: One of up to six waves Walthall threw at Casement and Reilly [wp].

units.name: Shelley's brigade (Walthall)
units.note: Intermixed with Loring's men in the narrowing ground between railroad and river [wp].

units.name: Cockrell's brigade (French)
units.note: Went in with 696 officers and men and lost 419 [cox].

units.name: Sears's brigade (French)
units.note: French's second brigade; Ector's brigade was away guarding the pontoon train [cox].

units.name: Granbury's brigade (Cleburne)
units.note: Broke in east of the pike beside Gordon; Granbury was killed and a captain led the brigade afterwards [wp] [tnenc].

units.name: Govan's brigade (Cleburne)
units.note: Struck the cotton-gin salient; Cleburne was killed in this attack [wp] [hood].

units.name: Lowrey's brigade (Cleburne)
units.note: Cleburne's third line, formed at his request in depth [hood] [jesp].

units.name: Gordon's brigade (Brown)
units.note: Angled right in the advance, crossed the pike and broke in with Cleburne; Gordon was captured [wp].

units.name: Strahl's brigade (Brown)
units.note: Fought in the ditch west of the pike for hours; Strahl was killed [wp] [hood].

units.name: Carter's brigade (Brown)
units.note: Struck Strickland and Moore west of Locust Grove; Carter was mortally wounded [wp] [jesp].

units.name: Gist's brigade (Brown)
units.note: Brown's left front brigade; Gist was killed [wp] [hood].

units.name: Smith's (Tyler's) brigade (Bate)
units.note: Bate's long march round the left reached the works near the Carter's Creek Pike only at dusk [wp].

units.name: Jackson's brigade (Bate)
units.note: Swept past Everbright and stalled against Moore and Grose [wp] [jesp].

units.name: Florida brigade (Bullock) (Bate)
units.note: Moved from reserve to cover Bate's open left flank, leaving no second line [wp].

units.name: Deas's brigade (Johnson)
units.note: Johnson's division attacked west of the pike about 7 p.m., lost its alignment in the dark and was repulsed in one assault [wp] [hood].

units.name: Manigault's brigade (Johnson)
units.note: Johnson's division attacked west of the pike about 7 p.m., lost its alignment in the dark and was repulsed in one assault [wp] [hood].

units.name: Sharp's brigade (Johnson)
units.note: Johnson's division attacked west of the pike about 7 p.m., lost its alignment in the dark and was repulsed in one assault [wp] [hood].

units.name: Brantley's brigade (Johnson)
units.note: Johnson's division attacked west of the pike about 7 p.m., lost its alignment in the dark and was repulsed in one assault [wp] [hood].

units.name: Chalmers's cavalry division (Forrest)
units.note: Fought dismounted against Kirby and Whitaker; Bate did not know it was engaged [wp].

units.name: Buford's cavalry division (Forrest)
units.note: Crossed at Hughes's Ford to turn the Union left and was driven back over the river by Wilson [wp] [abt].

units.name: W. H. Jackson's cavalry division (Forrest)
units.note: With Buford across Hughes's Ford; outgunned by Croxton's Spencers [wp] [abt].

units.name: Confederate batteries in action
units.note: Hood says he withheld artillery to spare the town; Cox finds only two batteries under fire [hood] [cox].

hq.name: Schofield
hq.note: Directed the battle from Fort Granger across the river [jesp] [cox].

hq.name: Cox
hq.note: Commanded the line from his station on the pike by the Carter House [cox].

hq.name: Hood
hq.note: Watched from Winstead Hill, two miles south [fw] [wp].
